title: membrane-brain: a brain-shaped toy for a holographic-membrane associative memory with a refusal gate (synthetic)
description: Synthetic, stdlib-only Python toy: 128 seeded neurons in two ellipses, four stored wave fields, a one-shot outer-product associative memory and a frozen refusal gate. It is not a brain, not neuroscience and not a medical or clinical tool. The repository documents measured behaviour and limits, including negative results. v0.2.0 adds an 808 nm light-dose coupling: a hormetic ATP proxy lowers effective probe noise, mitochondrial stress raises it, and light before stress onset protects recall more than the same light after onset. The light claims are pre-registered and measured in results/results_light.json.
